# Vendored icon sources

Raw upstream SVGs behind `../AppGlyphs.generated.tsx` and the mobile
`CanopyGlyph` assets. `../icon-manifest.json` decides which files are needed.
`pnpm run icons:generate --fetch` downloads them from the pinned sources
below; `pnpm run icons:check` fails when a file is missing, unused, or out of
step with the generated module. Do not edit these files by hand.

| Directory       | Source                                                                                                  | Pin                                               | License                                       |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `lucide/`       | [lucide-icons/lucide](https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide), `lucide-static` raw `icons/<name>.svg`   | `1.59.0`                                          | ISC and Feather-derived MIT, `lucide/LICENSE` |
| `material/`     | Legacy Material Symbols generator support; license retained, no current app SVGs                        | commit `49d4db35df873165d6bd6ba09b063c7dafbac2f4` | Apache-2.0, `material/LICENSE`                |
| `simple-icons/` | [simple-icons](https://www.npmjs.com/package/simple-icons) `icons/<slug>.svg`                           | `16.35.0`                                         | CC0-1.0, `simple-icons/LICENSE`               |
| `lobehub/`      | [@lobehub/icons-static-svg](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@lobehub/icons-static-svg) `icons/<slug>.svg` | `1.95.1`                                          | MIT, `lobehub/LICENSE`                        |
| `octicons/`     | [@primer/octicons](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@primer/octicons) `build/svg/<name>-24.svg`            | `19.40.0`                                         | MIT, `octicons/LICENSE`                       |

## Lucide

The app UI uses Lucide 1.59.0. SVGs are stored byte-for-byte from the pinned
`lucide-static` npm tarball; the manifest records its integrity hash. Rendering
uses a 2px stroke, round line ends and joins, and the shared 20px regular /
14px compact tiers. No icon-library runtime dependency is installed.

Filled state pairs fill the same Lucide silhouette. The filled close circle
uses a transparent X cutout, generated by the shared fill recipe for desktop,
web and mobile. Brand and provider marks keep their own artwork and sizing
contracts.

`lucide/LICENSE` contains both the ISC license and the MIT notice for icons
derived from Feather. Fetch URLs are pinned to
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lucide-static@1.59.0/icons/<name>.svg`.

## Legacy Material Symbols support

The generator can still read style Rounded, weight 300, grade 0, optical size 24. The current app manifest uses Lucide instead. Material files keep their upstream
names: `<name>_wght300_24px.svg` for FILL 0 and `<name>_wght300fill1_24px.svg`
for FILL 1. They are stored byte-for-byte as published. Four of them
(`auto_awesome`, `auto_mode`, `push_pin` and its FILL 1 variant) still use the
older 24-unit format at the pinned commit; the generator reads their size as
the viewBox.

Fetched from
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/material-design-icons/49d4db35df873165d6bd6ba09b063c7dafbac2f4/symbols/web/<name>/materialsymbolsrounded/<file>`.
Material Symbols are © Google LLC, licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

An entry marked `"upstream": "release"` is fetched from the Google Fonts
release instead, because the repository still has an older design of it:
`https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/i/short-term/release/materialsymbolsrounded/<name>/wght300/24px.svg`
(`wght300fill1` for FILL 1). Its file keeps the repository naming. Today that
was `automation` (`WorkflowsIcon`, `WorkflowIcon`, `Workflow`).

## Simple Icons and LobeHub Icons

Fetched from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/simple-icons@16.35.0/icons/<slug>.svg`
and `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@lobehub/icons-static-svg@1.95.1/icons/<slug>.svg`.
The npm tarballs and their integrity hashes are recorded in the manifest's
`sources`. At fetch time the generator removes `<title>` and every colour,
size, and inline-style attribute, so each mark renders monochrome in
`currentColor`.

The `@lobehub/icons-static-svg` package ships no license file. Its
`package.json` declares MIT; `lobehub/LICENSE` is the upstream repository's
license at commit `8a1b2821bb768c484fe8da20c5e1838b6bf551a9` of
[lobehub/lobe-icons](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons).

| File                        | Mark                                             |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `simple-icons/apple.svg`    | Apple (`ApplePlatformIcon`)                      |
| `simple-icons/deepseek.svg` | DeepSeek (`DeepSeekIcon`)                        |
| `simple-icons/git.svg`      | Git (`GitIcon`), see attribution below           |
| `simple-icons/kimi.svg`     | Kimi / Moonshot AI (`MoonshotIcon`)              |
| `simple-icons/minimax.svg`  | MiniMax (`MiniMaxIcon`)                          |
| `simple-icons/vercel.svg`   | Vercel AI Gateway (`VercelIcon`)                 |
| `lobehub/openrouter.svg`    | OpenRouter (`OpenRouterIcon`)                    |
| `lobehub/zai.svg`           | Z.ai (`ZaiIcon`)                                 |
| `lobehub/microsoft.svg`     | Windows four-square mark (`WindowsPlatformIcon`) |

## Octicons

The GitHub mark only. Git and GitHub concepts (branch, commit, merge, pull
request states, fork, diff, repository) moved to Lucide on 2026-11-03 so they
match the rest of the set; merge queue is the Canopy-drawn `IconMergeQueue`
in `../CanopyGlyphs.tsx`. Fetched from
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@primer/octicons@19.40.0/build/svg/<name>-24.svg`;
the npm tarball and its integrity hash are recorded in the manifest's
`sources`. At fetch time the generator strips it the same way as Simple Icons
and LobeHub marks. Octicons are © GitHub, Inc., licensed under the MIT License.

| File                          | Inset | Exports                              |
| ----------------------------- | ----- | ------------------------------------ |
| `octicons/mark-github-24.svg` | 1.5   | GitHub mark (`GitHubIcon`, `Github`) |
